q2.sampleAnswer: Z-transform of the DT system: Y(z) = (1 + a Ts) z^-1 Y(z) + Ts z^-1 U(z), so H(z) = 1 / (z/Ts - (1 + a Ts)/Ts). Matching denominators with H(s): z/Ts - (1 + a Ts)/Ts = s - a  =>  z = 1 + s Ts (equivalently, z = e^(s Ts) ~ 1 + s Ts, the forward Euler approximation).

q3.sampleAnswer: With z = 1 + s Ts, Re(s) < 0 maps to Re((z - 1)/Ts) < 0, i.e. Re(z) < 1: the open half-plane to the left of the vertical line Re(z) = 1. Rubric: 1 point for the correct region, 2 points for the correct argument.

q5.sampleAnswer: Closed loop: W(z) = K H(z) / (1 + K H(z)) = K b / (a z^-1 + (1 + K b)) (2 points). W(1) = 3b / (a + 1 + 3b) = 1/2 and W(-1) = 3b / (-a + 1 + 3b) = 3/2, i.e. 6b = a + 1 + 3b and 2b = -a + 1 + 3b. Summing: 8b = 2 + 6b => b = 1, then a = 2 (2 points each for setup and solution).

q6.sampleAnswer: Closed-loop denominator a z^-1 + (1 + 6) = a z^-1 + 7 gives the pole z = -a/7 (magnitude |a|/7). BIBO stable iff |a/7| < 1, i.e. |a| < 7.

q7.sampleAnswer: Write u[n] = a_0 e^(j0n) + a_1 (e^(j pi/2 n) + e^(-j pi/2 n))/2 + a_2 e^(j pi n) (1 point). Need H(1) = 1, H(-1) = 2, H(e^(j pi/2)) = 0, H(e^(-j pi/2)) = 0 (1 point each). A FIR filter is guaranteed stable (1 point); causality by multiplying by z^-N (1 point). Zeros at +-j: H_1(z) = alpha (z^2 + 1), with alpha = 1/2 so H_1(1) = H_1(-1) = 1. A first-order factor H_2(z) = 3/2 z - 1/2 adjusts the gains at Omega = 0 and Omega = pi (2 points, one per condition). Result: H(z) = 1/2 (z^2 + 1)(3/2 z - 1/2) z^-3, where z^-3 makes the filter causal (1 point); check: H(1) = 1, H(-1) = 2, H(+-j) = 0. Any causal stable filter meeting the four frequency conditions is acceptable.

With causality, recursing h[n] = -h[n-1] + delta[n-1] + delta[n-4] gives h[n] = {0, 1, -1, 1, 0, 0, ...} for n >= 0 (h[n] = 0 for n < 0).
